errors.text_span: Оста Y представлява стойности в милиони лева
errors.evidence: The Y-axis has no units specified. The figure caption indicates it is an index with 2007 as the base year (2007=100), not absolute values in millions of leva.

errors.text_span: скалата започва от 80 милиона и достига до 140 милиона
errors.evidence: The Y-axis scale shown in the image starts at 40, not 80.

errors.text_span: стойностите са разположени на интервали от 10 милиона в началото, а интервалите се намаляват до 10 милиона през 2016 г.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis has a consistent linear scale with major tick marks at intervals of 20 units. The description of changing intervals is completely inaccurate.

errors.text_span: достига до около 130 милиона лева през 2015 г., след което намалява до около 100 милиона лева през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The blue line (БВП) does not peak in 2015, nor does it decrease to 100 by 2018. It shows a steady increase throughout this period, reaching approximately 125 in 2018.

errors.text_span: започва на стойност около 80 милиона лева през 2007 г.
errors.evidence: The red line (частни инвестиции) starts at a value of 100 in 2007, not 80.

errors.text_span: достига до пик от около 120 милиона лева през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The peak for the red line is in 2008 at a value over 120. In 2015, the line is near a local minimum, not a peak.

errors.text_span: намалява до около 80 милиона лева през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The red line ends at a value of approximately 95 in 2018, not 80.

errors.text_span: започва на стойност около 80 милиона лева през 2007 г.
errors.evidence: The green line (публични инвестиции) starts at a value of 100 in 2007, not 80.

errors.text_span: след което се стабилизира на около 80 милиона лева до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The green line is extremely volatile after 2011, with a massive spike to over 140 in 2015 and a sharp drop to below 60 in 2017. Describing this as 'stabilized' is a gross misrepresentation of the data.

errors.text_span: има по-малки вариации по оста X в сравнение с другите две линии
errors.evidence: This is the opposite of what the chart shows. The green line has by far the largest and most dramatic variations of the three lines.
The description fails to mention the different markers used for each line (diamonds, squares, triangles), which are part of the legend and help distinguish the series.
